title: Symbolic Separation: Grounding Deep Agents in Knowledge Graphs for Trustworthy Operational Data Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2609.17107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI promises natural language access to the massive numerical telemetry of data centers and Industry 4.0 installations, yet text-to-query and tool-using agents stay unreliable: even frontier models answer little more than half of real-world database questions, and far fewer of the multi-step, operational ones, because the LLM must compose how heterogeneous sources relate and hallucinates the relations, not just the fields. We propose symbolic separation: a deep agent reasons freely but may act on data only through an ontology-constrained Virtual Knowledge Graph with deterministic pre-execution validation. Unlike a tool API's interface contract, this domain-semantic contract turns a complex question into one validated graph traversal instead of LLM-inferred joins. translated_title: 符号分离：将深度智能体植根于知识图谱以实现可信的运营数据分析
translated_abstract: 生成式AI承诺为数据中心和工业4.0设施的海量数值遥测数据提供自然语言访问，然而文本到查询和工具使用型智能体仍然不可靠：即使是最前沿的模型，也只能回答略过一半的现实世界数据库问题，而对于多步骤的运营性问题，回答率则更低，因为LLM必须自行推断异构数据源之间的关联方式，从而不仅幻觉字段，还会幻觉这些关系。我们提出符号分离：深度智能体可以自由推理，但只能通过带有确定性预执行验证的本体约束虚拟知识图谱对数据进行操作。与工具API的接口契约不同，这种领域语义契约将复杂问题转化为一次经过验证的图遍历，而非LLM推断的连接操作。该方法被实例化为神经符号深度分析师，并在49.9 TB的超级计算机遥测数据上，与刚性工作流及非符号消融版本进行对比评估，它提升了端（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出符号分离方法，让深度智能体自由推理但仅通过本体约束的虚拟知识图谱进行数据操作，将复杂问题转化为确定性的经验证的图遍历，从而大幅提升大模型在运营数据分析中的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes symbolic separation, where deep agents reason freely but act on data only through an ontology-constrained Virtual Knowledge Graph with deterministic pre-execution validation, converting complex questions into validated graph traversals to substantially improve the trustworthiness of LLM-based operational data analytics.
